description: Lists the mailbox's drafts: draft id plus the underlying message's id and threadId (no subjects — read one with get_draft). query filters with Gmail query syntax (e.g. subject:invoice); paginate with page_token from nextPageToken.

query.description: Gmail query syntax, e.g. "from:amy@example.com is:unread newer_than:7d has:attachment subject:invoice". Same operators as the Gmail search box.

name: list_drafts
title: List drafts
